subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope-shaped internal traces be blocked by a broader shared outbound sanitizer or by a Discord-specific front-channel sanitizer?
rationale: The unresolved fix crosses a security-sensitive channel boundary where overmatching can suppress legitimate user-visible JSON/code while undermatching continues to expose internal tool traces.

options.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
options.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer for envelope-shaped internal traces and require cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

options.title: Discord-specific sanitizer
options.body: Keep the broader rule in Discord reply/send delivery only and prove sibling channels either already sanitize or do not receive the same envelope shapes.

options.title: Defer to broad channel policy
options.body: Block this issue behind the broader inter-tool text leakage policy and accept that the Discord-specific envelope remainder stays open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
recommendation.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer for envelope-shaped internal traces and require cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across both likely implementation paths: shared tool-call repair and Discord reply-safety.
